snippet.title: Half-Life Arena | Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the chaos of classic Half-Life deathmatch, boiled down to a compact package designed for 2-8 players. Inspired by Head-to-Head mode from Playstation 2 version of the original game, Arena sets out to provide intense non-stop action! 

Now available on Steam!
